headline: Approved field trip, LMS Sunday football discretion, MMA workers' comp resolve, and SVPP-COPS school security grant application
summary: The committee approved a field trip to Colleges of the Fenway in Boston, allowed Superintendent discretion for LMS football on Sundays, approved a Maine Municipal Association Workers' Compensation fund resolve, and approved submitting an SVPP-COPS grant for school security. After an executive session on a personnel matter, the committee voted that cause was found for a term hearing.
decisions: Approved the field trip request to attend Colleges of the Fenway in Boston, MA, 8-0.
Approved allowing the Superintendent discretion for LMS football games on Sundays as needed, 7-0.
Approved the resolve in the Maine Municipal Association Workers' Compensation fund, 7-0.
Approved submitting an SVPP-COPS grant to improve school security systems and access points.
Found cause for a term hearing following executive session, 6-1 with Scott Harriman opposed.

decision_evidence.quote: VOTED: (1) Motion to approve the field trip request to attend Colleges of the Fenway in Boston, MA. Janet Beaudoin – Meghan Hird (8-0).
VOTED: (2) Motion to allow at Superintendent’s discretion LMS football on Sundays as needed. Janet Beaudoin – Luke Jensen (7-0).
VOTED: (3) Motion to approve the resolve in the Maine Municipal Association Workers’ Compensation fund. Janet Beaudoin – Luke Jensen (7-0).
VOTED: (4) Motion to approve request for submitting an SVPP-COPS grant to improve school security systems and access points.
VOTED: (6) Motion is we find cause for a term hearing. Janet Beaudoin – Luke Jensen (6-1) Scott Harriman

PUBLIC INPUT

community together. 
Amron – Resources for youth in community. Conflict resolution through sports. Youth want to help
